name: After § 12
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 17p. Welcomes the possibility of using EU funds, especially cohesion policy funds, to finance decent, affordable and sustainable housing, which is an essential investment for strengthening economic, social and territorial cohesion, combating energy poverty and social exclusion, and supporting labour mobility and the attractiveness of regions; considers that the significant contribution of cohesion policy funds to this specific objective in the NRPPs should be taken into account when determining the overall envelope of the policy;
